title: 第15章 职业的选择第16章 未来和幸福

第十五章 职业的选择
实际年龄已经三十岁的秦岚，是从内心抗拒即将再去上学的事实……但是，既然已经决定要在这个异世界角逐和闯荡，自然不能对这个世界一无所知，最终秦岚不得不咬着牙齿点头。只是上学而已了，反正在家里呆着也是玩游戏罢，去那边，如果有东西学自然是最好，没有东西学的话，一样可以进入游戏打发时间。
只是，事情远比他想象的复杂。
原本的秦岚在秦府生活了十六年，几乎都没有出过府，他的存在也刻意被忽略了，秦家最出彩最有名的，是秦衾秦笉这对双胞胎姐妹花，她们因为长的漂亮，在同龄人中自然人气不小。但是这一次秦岚突然翻身，不但成为了秦府的主人，秦家的三姐妹更是相继沦落，帝都到处贴出了缉拿她们的通告。
这其中的原因自然不能为外人道明，所以，民众们一头雾水的同时，也莫名的对秦岚有了一丝不喜欢的情绪，毕竟来说，女孩子一般都站在弱者一方。这一点在同龄人身上体现的更加明显，所以，秦岚第一次抵达异世界传说中的学院的时候，迎接他的，是无数充满了敌意的眼睛。
秦岚的接受能力还算不错，心理年龄三十岁的他，当然不会跟这些小屁孩去计较什么。星岚学院，是以星岚帝国为名的学院，帝国在其中投入了大量的人力物力以及资源，因此，在牧图大陆上的众多学院中，星岚学院虽然不是排名第一，但是怎么说也是在排在前十的优秀存在。
进入这所学院并不难，帝都以及帝都附近周边的适合年龄的孩子，只要通过简单的考核，就可以进入学院深造，如果天赋好的，学院甚至可以减免学费或者出资赞助，这也是为什么，秦不群只是打个招呼，秦岚就可以入学的原因。但是，想要从学院毕业，就很难了。牧图大陆上所有的学院都是一样，宽入严出。学院里面没有什么年级，也没有什么系别，它就是一个大整体，所有入学的学生都是同学。
每个新学员在新入学的时候都要选择一个自己的主学科，然后再选择一个副职业。比如，你选择的主学科是战士，那么你还可以选择一个副职业，成为法师？牧师？祭祀？弓箭手？……都随便你，你想选择什么选择什么。而且，在学院里的学习是没有学科限制的。虽然你的主学科是战士，你的副职业是采集者，但是你一样可以天天去法师塔上课学习魔法……
也就是说，你可以在学院里，学习任何你感兴趣的课程，没有人会对你有任何的不满，甚至你不来上课都行，只要你的主学科和副职业在每年的年终考核上都达到了学院承认的标准，你就可以顺利的混玩四年，然后轻松毕业。反之，达不到要求的话你就一直呆在学院里吧，一辈子达不到标准，那么你一辈子就无法毕业。只是无法毕业也就算了，很多人悠哉游哉，慢慢混时间也是不错的选择，但是每年不菲的学费绝对会让人心痛，而那些拿资助或者减免学费的学员，一旦每年的考核不达标，就有可能被取消掉资格，从而失去在学院进修的资格。
秦岚此刻就是正在面对着满墙的课程选择发呆……谁说异世界就是简单加弱智的文明？一方水土养一方人，独特的地理环境还有特别的生存理念，构造了牧图大陆人类数千年的辉煌。人类为什么可以称霸大陆？他们用什么在诸多强横的异族手下抢占最富饶的大陆中央之地？？靠的是学习，靠的是创造，靠的是精确到包含一切的细化职业！
牧图大陆上异族众多，而所谓的异族，就是与人类共同生活在牧图大陆的非人类智慧种族，其中最典型的，是精灵族，兽人族，矮人族，哥特斯族，海族，以及以龙族为代表的一些高智慧生命。
在大陆的历史记载中，神创造了众多的种族，而人类是他最后的杰作。虽然人类没有如其它种族一般拥有各种神奇而强大的能力，但是人类有一种独特的，让神也引以为傲的天赋，那就是，学习和创造。人类出现的时候，牧图大陆还处于精灵们的统治之下，强大的魔法能力让精灵们无数次打败了兽人的进攻，一直把持着大陆的霸权，弱小而孱弱的人类的出现，引起众多强悍种族的一阵哄笑……可是，人类在兽人这里学会了斗气，人类在精灵哪里学会了魔法，人类在矮人这边学会了锻造……
数个千年过去之后，精灵被人类驱赶着躲进了大陆西南方的茫茫林海，兽人被放逐到了大陆西北面贫瘠而荒凉的艾尔摩高原，矮人早早的龟缩在了大陆最北面长期冰封的漠云山脉里，就连个体强大而且生命漫长的龙族，也被迫从龙之谷迁徙，在星海之中寻找了一处荒凉的岛屿住下。只有海族生活在海底，哥特斯族生活在天空中的浮动岛屿，他们幸运的，没有争夺大陆统治权的条件，因此逃过一劫，大陆的霸权从此被人类抓在了手中。
但是，并不是说异族就此善罢甘休，被放逐的兽人，饱受贫穷和饥饿的折磨，他们无时无刻不在窥探着大路中央的富饶之地，只要有机会，他们就会倾巢而出，为了种族的生存和繁衍，兽人们从来都是奋不顾身的，人类和兽人边境的要塞还有周围的山脉，是大陆上唯一的一块血红色土地，满山遍野的红，还有那累累的永远也清理不干净的残尸骸骨，让那里成为了亡灵的乐园。
就连精灵族，也一直想要夺回大陆的霸权，让精灵女神的荣耀挂满大陆。
所以，尽管人类取得了大陆的霸权，但是危机依然时刻存在。在这个危机与挑战的并存的世界，战斗是主旋律，所衍生出来的战斗职业，也就成为了覆盖全民的一张大网。
这就是为什么学院要求每个人选择一个主职业和一个副职业的原因。当战斗来临的时候，每个人抓起武器，就是能够保家卫国的战士！！

Chapter 15 Career Choice
Qin Lan, who is actually thirty years old, is resisting from the bottom of her heart the fact that she is about to go to school again... However, since she has decided to compete and struggle in this different world, she naturally cannot know nothing about this world. In the end, Qin Lan had to grit her teeth and nod. It's just school. Anyway, staying at home is all about playing games. If you go there, it's best if you have something to learn. If you don't have anything to learn, you can still play games to kill time.
However, things were far more complicated than he imagined.
The original Qin Lan lived in the Qin Mansion for sixteen years and almost never left the house, and his existence was deliberately ignored. The most outstanding and famous ones in the Qin family were the twin sisters Qin Qui and Qin Jian. Because of their beauty, they were naturally quite popular among their peers. But this time Qin Lan suddenly turned around and not only became the master of the Qin Mansion, but the three sisters of the Qin family were also killed one after another. Notices for their apprehension were posted everywhere in the imperial capital.
The reason for this cannot be explained to outsiders. Therefore, while the people were confused, they also had an inexplicable dislike for Qin Lan. After all, girls generally stand on the side of the weak. This was even more obvious among his peers, so when Qin Lan arrived at the legendary academy in another world for the first time, he was greeted by countless eyes full of hostility.
Qin Lan's ability to accept things is pretty good. With a mental age of thirty, he certainly won't argue with these little brats. Xinglan College is a college named after the Xinglan Empire. The empire has invested a lot of manpower, material and resources in it. Therefore, among the many colleges on the Mutu Continent, although Xinglan College is not ranked first, it is still in the top ten outstanding existences.
It is not difficult to enter this college. Children of the right age from the Imperial Capital and its surroundings can enter the college for further study as long as they pass a simple assessment. If they are talented, the college can even waive tuition or provide financial sponsorship. This is why Qin Lan can enroll just by saying hello to Qin Buqun. However, it is difficult to graduate from the academy. All academies on the Mutu Continent are the same, with easy entry and strict exit. There are no grades or departments in the college. It is just a big whole, and all the students who enroll are classmates.
Every new student must choose a major subject when they first enter the school, and then choose a secondary career. For example, if the main discipline you choose is a warrior, then you can also choose a secondary profession and become a mage? priest? Sacrifice? Archer? ...It's all up to you, choose whatever you want. Moreover, there are no discipline restrictions for studying in the academy. Although your main subject is a warrior and your secondary profession is a gatherer, you can still go to the Mage Tower every day to take classes to learn magic...
That is to say, you can study any course you are interested in in the college, and no one will have any dissatisfaction with you, even if you don't come to class. As long as your main subject and secondary occupation meet the standards recognized by the college in the annual end-of-year assessment, you can smoothly play around for four years and then graduate easily. On the contrary, if you cannot meet the requirements, you can stay in the college. If you cannot meet the standards in your life, you will not be able to graduate in your life. It's okay if you just can't graduate. Many people are leisurely and leisurely, and leisurely leisurely is also a good choice. However, the high annual tuition fees will definitely make people feel heartbroken. And those students who receive subsidies or tuition exemptions may be disqualified once the annual assessment fails to meet the standards, and thus lose the qualification to study in the college.
Qin Lan is currently in a daze facing the wall full of course choices... Who said that another world is a simple and mentally retarded civilization? The land and water support the people, the unique geographical environment and the special concept of survival have formed the basis for thousands of people in Mutu Continent.years of glory. Why can humans dominate the continent? What did they use to seize the most fertile land in the center of the continent from the many tyrannical alien races? ? It relies on learning, it relies on creation, it relies on detailed work that is precise enough to include everything!
There are many alien races on the Mutu Continent, and the so-called alien races are non-human intelligent races that live together with humans on the Mutu Continent. The most typical ones are the elves, orcs, dwarves, Goths, sea people, and some highly intelligent life forms represented by the dragons.
In the historical records of the continent, God created many races, and human beings were his last masterpiece. Although humans do not have all kinds of magical and powerful abilities like other races, humans have a unique talent that makes gods proud, that is, learning and creation. When humans appeared, the Mutu Continent was still under the rule of the elves. Their powerful magical abilities allowed the elves to defeat the attacks of the orcs countless times, and they have always maintained the hegemony of the continent. The appearance of weak and weak humans caused a burst of laughter from many powerful races... However, humans learned fighting spirit from the orcs, humans learned magic from the elves, and humans learned forging from the dwarves...
Thousands of years later, the elves were driven by humans and hid in the vast forest sea in the southwest of the continent. The orcs were banished to the barren and desolate Elmo Plateau in the northwest of the continent. The dwarves had long since huddled in the long-frozen Moyun Mountains in the northernmost part of the continent. Even the dragons, who were individually powerful and lived a long life, were forced to migrate from the Dragon Valley and find a desolate island to live in among the stars. Only the Sea Tribe lives on the bottom of the sea, and the Gothic Tribe lives on floating islands in the sky. Fortunately, they do not have the conditions to compete for the dominance of the mainland, so they escaped. The hegemony of the mainland has since been captured by humans.
However, this does not mean that the aliens will just give up. The exiled orcs are suffering from poverty and hunger. They are spying on the rich land in the middle of the road all the time. As long as there is an opportunity, they will come out in full force. For the survival and reproduction of the race, the orcs They have always worked hard without caring about their own safety. The fortress on the border between humans and orcs and the surrounding mountains are the only blood-red land on the continent. The red mountains and plains, as well as the numerous corpses and bones that can never be cleaned up, make it a paradise for the undead.
Even the elves have always wanted to regain the hegemony of the continent and let the glory of the elven goddess hang all over the continent.
Therefore, although humans have achieved hegemony on the continent, crises still exist all the time. In this world where crises and challenges coexist, fighting is the main theme, and the fighting professions derived from it have become a big network covering the whole people.
This is why the academy requires everyone to choose a primary career and a secondary career. When the battle comes, everyone grabs a weapon and is a warrior who can protect his home and country! !
